The '''Tof bulk cruiser''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] used by the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]].

==History==
These bulk cruisers were used by the Tofs as they chased the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] from [[Firefist]] to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were used in the war against the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], with the [[Wayfarer (Tof starship)|''Wayfarer'']] delivering Tof invaders to [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] before being destroyed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Months later, the bulk cruiser ''[[Merriweather]]'' squared off against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] commandeered [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Emancipator]]''.<ref name="EGW" />
